audit_items.proof_trace: All three safety-check callers refresh debt interest before checking obligation health: handle_withdraw (L326) and liquidation_inner (L720) call refresh_obligation_assets_interest (which covers all debts + collaterals); handle_borrow (L407) calls refresh_obligation_borrow_interest_with_new_borrow, which accrues all existing debt reserves and then the new debt reserve. Even without an explicit obligation.accrue_interest call, debts_value_usd_non_liquidation (L1194) computes debt as amount * reserve.borrow_index() / old_index, so it always uses the fresh reserve borrow index. Skipping collateral interest on the borrow path is intentionally documented (comment at L406) and makes the safety check more conservative, not less.
